scope: Pilot: source-backed wastewater catchments for Lynetten, Damhusåen and Mølleåværket across Copenhagen, Gentofte, Frederiksberg, Herlev, Rødovre, Lyngby-Taarbæk and Gladsaxe and Rudersdal
notes: Relations are included only where an official municipal wastewater-plan source identifies the receiving treatment plant. Current subcatchment numbers are preferred when older catchment numbers have been split. Relation-level municipalityCode supports cross-municipality catchments. Ambiguous or contradictory relations are deliberately excluded. This pilot is not a complete treatment-plant catchment and must be labelled as partial in the UI. Current letter/dot subdivisions may inherit a documented numeric parent only when the current Plandata sewer code is 1, 2 or 3; type 6 is never inherited automatically.
